store.title: Store
store.intro: Sell presets, albums, sessions and gift cards. Clients order from your shop page and pay you directly.
store.enabledHint: Your shop is open. Clients can browse your products and place orders.
store.disabledHint: Your shop is closed. Turn it on when your products are ready; nobody can order until then.
store.noSlug: Your shop needs a public address like photnoo.com/p/your-name/shop. <link>Choose your handle in Settings</link> to publish it.
store.saveFailed: That change wasn't saved. Check your connection and try again.
store.empty: Add your first product: a preset pack, an album, a session or a gift card. Each one gets its own link you can share.

image.hint: JPEG or PNG, up to 15 MB. Click or drop a file here.
image.type: Choose a JPEG or PNG image.
image.tooLarge: This image is larger than 15 MB. Export a smaller copy.

drawer.name: Product name
drawer.salePriceHint: Shown with the regular price struck through.
drawer.availabilityHint: Out of stock products stay visible but can't be ordered.
drawer.priceInvalid: Enter a price in EGP, e.g. 450.
drawer.saleTooHigh: The sale price must be lower than the price.
drawer.imageFailed: The product was saved, but the picture wasn't. Use a JPEG or PNG up to 15 MB and try again.
drawer.deleteBody: The product and its picture are deleted. This can't be undone.
drawer.archiveBody: This product has orders, so it's taken off your shop and kept for those orders. Clients can no longer order it.
